reason: Calling-convention macro tokens in pointer declarators and standard va_arg type operands are syntax, not expression errors.

replacements.after:
call_expression: $ => prec(PREC.CALL, choice(seq(
      field('function', $.expression),
      field('arguments', $.argument_list),
    ), seq(
      field('function', alias(choice('va_arg', '__builtin_va_arg'), $.identifier)),
      field('arguments', alias($._type_argument_list, $.argument_list)),
    ))),
    _type_argument_list: $ => seq('(', $.expression, ',', $.type_descriptor, ')'),

translation_unit: $ => repeat($._top_level_item),
    modifier_identifier: _ => /\x1f[A-Za-z0-9_]+/,
    macro_identifier: _ => /@[A-Za-z0-9_]+/,
    macro_declaration: $ => prec.right(2, seq(
      field('name', alias($.macro_identifier, $.identifier)),
      optional(field('arguments', alias($.macro_arguments, $.argument_list))),
    )),
    macro_block: $ => prec(3, seq(
      field('function', alias($.macro_identifier, $.identifier)),
      optional(field('arguments', alias($.macro_arguments, $.argument_list))),
      field('body', $.compound_statement),
    )),
    macro_statement: $ => prec.right(2, seq(field('name', alias($.macro_identifier, $.identifier)), optional(field('arguments', alias($.macro_arguments, $.argument_list))))),
    macro_arguments: $ => prec(4, seq('(', repeat($._macro_token), ')')),
    macro_brackets: $ => seq('[', repeat($._macro_token), ']'),
    macro_braces: $ => seq('{', repeat($._macro_token), '}'),
    _macro_token: $ => choice($.string_literal, $.char_literal, $.macro_arguments, $.macro_brackets, $.macro_braces, token(prec(1, /[^(){}\[\]"']+/))),

availability_expression: $ => seq(
      "__builtin_available", "(",
      commaSep1(choice(seq($.availability_platform, $.availability_version), "*")), ")",
    ),
    availability_platform: _ => /[A-Za-z_][A-Za-z_0-9]*/,
    availability_version: _ => /[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)*/,

    expression: $ => choice(
      $.availability_expression,
      $._expression_not_binary,
